required_outcomes: Records Alder Compliance's report at event 020 as the work result: cylinder and handles replaced, remaining keys to be dropped at the office the next day.
Sets a dated follow-up for the landlord's and agency's keys to arrive at the office, and does not record them as returned yet.
Lets the landlord (Quinn) know the lock has been replaced and that his key will be at the office once the provider drops it off.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the tenant to confirm the new lock works and that she has her keys before the job is closed.
Moving the job to the result or final-checks stage now, with closure left until the keys are in and any invoice is received.
Skipping the quote document with the reason that no quote was needed and the repair was done on site.
positive_behaviours: Asks Alder to confirm how many keys were cut and how many went to the tenants, against the four requested.
Asks Alder to send the invoice so the cost can be checked, since no amount was agreed in advance.
red_flags: Closing the job straight away on the provider's promise, before the keys reach the office.
Escalating to a human when the work is done and nothing is in dispute.
prohibited_actions: Telling the landlord his key is at the office before it has arrived.
critical_failures: Recording the keys as returned to the office when the provider has only said they will be dropped off tomorrow.
